summary: Implemented rich_measure for Tree and added rich.align.VerticalCenter. Changes: rich/tree.py adds Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative DFS, 4-cell indent per level, Measurement import from .measure). rich/align.py adds Align.__repr__, width constraint to measured maximum (min with explicit width), and VerticalCenter class with render, measure, and repr. rich/console.py sets render_options justify to "default" while collection still receives justify. CHANGELOG.md 9.8.0 marked Unreleased with Added entries. tests/test_tree.py and tests/test_align.py got new tests and imports. Nothing was run: tests, scripts, and installs were out of scope, so all verification is by reading. The nested-Align centering expectation is a hand calculation and should be checked when tests run; test_align_width is expected to still pass but is unverified. No commits made.
